name: py-topo-lex
instruction: Implement topo_lex.py: def topo_sort(graph: dict) -> list. The graph maps a node to the list of nodes it must come BEFORE (its dependents/successors). Return a topological order that is the LEXICOGRAPHICALLY SMALLEST of all valid orders - at every step, among the nodes whose prerequisites are all placed, emit the smallest by normal string comparison. Nodes that appear only as a successor still belong in the output. Raise ValueError if the graph contains a cycle. An empty graph returns an empty list.
gateCmd:
python3 - <<'GATEPY'
from topo_lex import topo_sort as t
assert t({'a': ['b']}) == ['a', 'b'], t({'a': ['b']})
print('gate ok')
GATEPY
